question: Can a parametric gate imitate the R66 fully factual protected-memory switch decision on independently sampled, unannounced causal changes, and preserve retention when closed-loop?
hypothesis: A learned nonlinear gate over ordered, post-event current-vs-alternative bank evidence will generalize better to unseen causal-switch worlds than matched order-invariant and randomized-label controls, while staying near the fixed R66 causal-memory retention performance.
null: A trained directional bank switch is not reliably recoverable from factual evidence, cannot preserve A on return, or has no usable advantage over matched controls.

source.split_balance: Each panel half stable A-A-A and half A-B-A. FIT/CAL switched balance 90-degree physical terminal rotation and 1.35 multiplicative selected-role goal gain. DEV switched balance 90-degree rotation and unseen role 0/1 goal-column swap.
source.regime_schedule: 48 factual events in public role order 0,1,2,3 repeating; 16 A, 16 B, 16 A_return; phase/regime always private to scorer, not training inputs.
source.selected_goal: Per-world 4x4 independent Gaussian(0, .75) causal selected action effect matrix with 0.25 diagonal; 4D observed terminal selected outcome plus Gaussian noise sigma .04; selected factual role and outcome only, post-action.
source.irrelevant_proxy: 4D iid normal std 0.8 with isolated DEV proxy-negative std 3.0, never forwarded to trainer or model.
source.unseen_DEV_family: role column swap B[:,0]=A[:,1] and B[:,1]=A[:,0] for changed roles 0,1; FIT never sees this transformation family. This is fresh author synthetic held-out family, not external independent OOD.
source.admission: Generate FIT, CAL, DEV with separate salts. Teacher labels on FIT are derived from R66 public factual prediction, after selected observed event, NEVER hidden law/regime/phase labels. CAL diagnostics only. DEV evaluated one time after weights frozen.
source.note: The first unannounced A return for each changed role (t32,t33) is not scored as clairvoyance.

teacher.reference: Unmodified qualified experiments.p85mr_f8r66_bank_identity.update_role_bank('protected_role_bank') on fresh R68 selected factual actions and outcomes.
teacher.mechanism: R66 exact post-event switch = (inactive bank trained norm >=0.20 and inactive L2 error +0.15 < active L2 error) OR (active bank trained norm >=0.20 and active L2 error >0.75 and inactive trained norm <0.20). Switch one role's active bank, write only its newly selected bank after actual goal outcome, eta 0.65.
teacher.labels: Binary event switch event derived from actual selected action and post-outcome bank predictions on the teacher's own state, NOT from private ground truth world/change label.
teacher.identity_check: Teacher trace must exactly reproduce original R66 per-event pre-observation MSE, cumulative switch count and final 36-float state hash before any imitation scoring.
teacher.features_candidate: Ten float64 inputs [log1p(norm_active),log1p(norm_inactive),log1p(err_active),log1p(err_inactive),err_active-err_inactive,err_active-0.75,norm_active-0.20,norm_inactive-0.20,err_active-err_inactive-0.15,1]. These are public AFTER the action outcome only.
teacher.features_nondirectional: Ten float64 magnitude/invariant variants, replacing ordered signs by unordered min/max or absolute deviation; no change of event information available, but cannot encode which bank has better match as directly.

arms.student: FULL_ORDERED_MLP: 10->16 tanh->1 float64 binary logit, 193 trainable global weights; 36 float persistent two-bank/role-selector world state; hard switch after outcome only.
controls: ORDER_INVARIANT_MLP: identical 10->16 tanh->1 / 193 trainable parameters with unordered features
FULL_ORDERED_LINEAR: logistic 10->1 / 11 trainable parameters with same ordered features
SHUFFLED_LABEL_MLP: identical 193-param ordered-feature MLP trained on FIT-only labels deterministically shuffled preserving FIT prevalence
FIXED_R66_ORACLE_TEACHER: source-neutral hand-engineered public-state decision, not a trained superior inference claim
arms.cost_note: Equal action information and fast-state capacity; training parameter count differs for linear, teacher has zero trainable globals. Report all train/eval wall times, steps, event exposures; no equal FLOP claim.

training.positive_BCE_weight: min(12, max(1, FIT_negative_switch_label_count/FIT_positive_switch_label_count)), fixed FIT-only, no CAL/DEV reweighting
training.loss: Weighted BCEWithLogitsLoss on all post-event factual teacher-state FIT switch/no-switch examples; no direct hidden law, future outcome, or private phase label.
training.shuffled_control: FIT binary switch labels deterministically permuted by rng 24059999 + seed for each training seed; retains identical switch prevalence, same optimizer steps and FIT event draws as other trained arms.
training.CAL: Read-only diagnostic, no hyperparameter choices or optimizer updates.
training.DEV: Weights frozen, evaluate teacher-state label agreement and independent closed-loop student rollouts on DEV with new unseen swap family; never train on DEV.

metrics.accuracy: Teacher-state switch label balanced accuracy, positive recall and negative specificity on fresh DEV factual teacher traces (zero positives causes source admission failure).
metrics.closed_loop: Student read-before-outcome and role-specific post-observation update from own state; no reference teacher labels or hidden private world states at inference.
metrics.primary: After-factual-evidence A-return changed-role MSE at t36,37,40,41,44,45; separate B changed-role MSE at t20,21,24,25,28,29 and stable-world all-48 MSE.
metrics.comparators: Fixed R66 teacher anchor; strongest TRAINED control by total joint B+A_return+stable is chosen among invariant MLP, ordered linear and shuffled-label MLP. Candidate must beat strongest TRAINED control by 5% joint MSE; do not silently omit linear or shuffled control.
metrics.scope_if_pass: DEV_TEACHER_IMITATION_MECHANISM_SIGNAL_ONLY, NOT independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS or trained Hybrid superiority
metrics.scope_if_fail: DEV_NO_GO, preserve negative, do not optimize on spent DEV.
